Focus on vocabulary Verbs
A Find the verbs in the story. Match them with their meanings. Write the letters a-h.
1. say (para. 1)
a. nod or smile to show you see someone
2. acknowledge (para. 4)
b. move something quickly so people don't notice
3. slip (para. 6)
c. hit with a flat hand
4. make eye contact (para. 6)
d. walk toward
5. venture (para. 10)
e. for example, like
6. make (your) way (para. 11)
f. go somewhere risky or unpleasant
7. slap down (para. 11)
g. look at someone directly in the eye
8. tug (para. 11)
h. pull hard
